description:
Sleep Therapy Bansuri 🌙 Soft Flute Music to Slow Your Breathing & Sleep Deeply Through the Night | Raag Kedar | 3 Hours | Episode 3 of Sleep Therapy

If your body is tired but your breath is still quick and shallow, sleep keeps slipping away. Let the flute slow it down for you.

This soft Indian flute music is designed to slow your breathing and carry you into deep sleep: low, breathy bamboo-flute notes with long pauses, so each breath can lengthen on its own.

Enjoy 3 hours of gentle bansuri (Indian bamboo flute) over a soft tanpura drone, with no percussion and no vocals.

🌙 SLEEP THERAPY is our Bansuri sleep series. This is Episode 3.
Episode 1 → https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bkLTwCakuLk
Episode 2 → https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SLEEP_EP2_VIDEO_ID

▶ Sleep through the night — the full Sleep Music playlist:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VIDEO_ID&list=PLeZN0byo199mx7da__pC4JseKqY856ABr
(paste this video's own id in place of VIDEO_ID before publishing — it opens the playlist at this video so the next one plays automatically)

Perfect for falling asleep, staying asleep, insomnia, a racing mind at night, slow breathing, yoga nidra, a late-night wind-down, naps, or keeping a calm sound in the room all night.

🎵 ABOUT THIS MUSIC
Instrument: Bansuri (Indian bamboo flute) with tanpura drone
Raga: Kedar (a peaceful night raga)
Style: Indian classical instrumental, sleep
Mood: Soft, slow, deeply restful
Atmosphere: A dark room, a cool breeze, breath slowing
Duration: 3 hours

🎧 HOW TO USE
Lights off, volume low, phone face down. Breathe in for four counts and out for six, and let the long flute notes set the rhythm until you stop counting.
